name: Warrior
description: Masters of physical combat, Warriors channel raw strength and endurance into devastating melee attacks. They are the backbone of any party.
flavor_text: Where others hesitate, the Warrior advances.

name: Mage
description: Students of the arcane arts, Mages wield elemental and destructive magic at the cost of physical fragility. Their potential is limitless.
flavor_text: Reality bends at the Mage's will.

name: Rogue
description: Shadows are their domain. Rogues strike from concealment with lethal precision, relying on speed and cunning over brute force.
flavor_text: The blade you never see is the one that kills you.

name: Priest
description: Conduits of divine energy, Priests sustain allies and smite the undead. Their faith is their weapon and their shield.
flavor_text: Faith is the armor no blade can pierce.

name: Ranger
description: Hunters of the wilds, Rangers excel at ranged combat and tracking. They form bonds with nature and strike enemies before they can react.
flavor_text: The arrow finds its mark before the enemy draws breath.
